messages:
Rina S: Heads-up 10: we need the benchmark creative pack ready for the webinar landing page and socials. Webinar Thu 9am PT. Deadline: Mon EOD for final exports.
Noah M: Scope check: benchmark tiles (3 stat variants), 2 hero sizes, 4 social cuts, email header, and a downloadable PDF one-pager?
Rina S: Correct. Also a simple diagram for the webinar slide that shows routing: demo flow -> model variants -> cost/latency tradeoffs. Keep it icon-led.
Theo D: Design ask: should the tiles surface absolute numbers or relative deltas? Legal prefers relative + "typical" qualifier.
Maya C: I'll handle tiles + PDF one-pager. Can do two visual styles (clean tech + narrative). First pass Wed AM. Need final copy and alt-text for accessibility.
Design Bot: Brand kit v3 attached. Use primary CTA color #0b6cff and secondary #0f1724. Recommended font: Inter variable. (auto)
Noah M: Ops: filename convention please so uploads are automated. Use: bench-<variant>_<lang>_<size>.png. Also add UTM: utm_source=bench-email&utm_campaign=webinar-apr.
OpsBot: Confirmed. Automation expects that pattern and language codes (en, fr, de, es). Will auto-attach metadata to HubSpot.
Maya C: Accessibility: will add alt text to Figma and include a contrast note. Can someone provide the short alt-lines (1 sentence each)?
Rina S: I'll draft alt text for 12 tiles by Tue. Also drafting two copy tones: "Engineer" and "PM-friendly".
Theo D: Webinar slide diagram: I'll sketch a simple flow in Figma and drop icons for the model variants. Want it lightweight for the slide deck.
Noah M: Legal note: avoid claims like "lowest inference cost". Use "cost-efficient inference" or "optimized cost per token". Also pre-approve any quantitative statements.
Maya C: Localization: do we want full localized hero art or only translated overlays? Full local heroes add ~6hrs per language.
Rina S: For FR/DE keep full localized overlay + translated captions. ES can be overlay only.
Maya C: Got it. I'll flag if layout breaks under FR/DE copy.
Noah M: Exports: provide PNG @2x for raster, SVG for icons, and a print-ready PDF for the one-pager. Email header: 600x200. Socials: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 1080x1920.
Design Bot: Export checklist added to ticket #7412. Include vector source and editable Figma frames. (auto)
Theo D: Note for the webinar hero: include speaker headshots with circular mask; send me headshot assets and bios.
Rina S: I'll push headshots to the Figma file by EOD. Bios live in the copy tab.
Maya C: ETA for first visuals: Wed 11:00 PT. I'll comment with any brand issues.
Noah M: After final exports, ops will map assets to LP and schedule GTM. Reminder: use tracking key bench_webinar_apr24.
Rina S: Thanks all. Action list: Rina = copy + alt-text, Maya = visuals + exports, Theo = slide diagram + icons, Noah = ops + tracking, Design Bot = brand pack. Review Mon 10am PT.
